source_summary: Snowy Chinese mountain landscape with pale green-gray atmospheric wash, layered ink-line peaks, bare winter trees, winding snowy paths, and several small pavilion/gate complexes with blue-gray roof accents.

motifs.name: upper_mist_wash
motifs.description: Isolate the broad pale green-gray atmospheric mist and cloud wash across the upper sky, including the faint horizontal tonal bands and distant speckled ink traces, while masking out mountain forms and architecture.
must_preserve: faint distant ink speckles at upper left
feathered mist edges around mountain silhouettes

motifs.name: central_snow_mountain_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the large central snow-covered mountain mass with layered rounded peaks and valleys, from the left shoulder up to the highest central summit and down into the central ravines.
must_preserve: thin gray contour lines along snow ridges
dense parallel cun-style texture strokes in ravines
soft wash shading at the mountain bases

motifs.name: right_snow_peak_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the tall right-side snowy peak ridge with steep central summit, descending serrated shoulders, and the smaller far-right rounded peaks behind it.
must_preserve: soft gray wash in recessed gullies

motifs.name: central_terraced_pavilion_complex
motifs.description: Isolate the multi-level pavilion and hall cluster on the central slope, including the stacked blue-gray roofs, railings, walls, lower platform, and the wooden scaffold-like terrace in front.
must_preserve: precise roof geometry with upturned eaves
fine ink railings and wall divisions
thin wooden support posts and platform lines

motifs.name: small_hillside_watchtower
motifs.description: Isolate the small freestanding tower or shrine on the right hillside, including its capped roof, slender shaft, base plinth, and surrounding tiny ink details immediately attached to it.

motifs.name: lower_right_walled_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right walled pavilion compound nestled among snowy hills, including the two small roofed towers, connecting wall, central hall lines, and enclosed courtyard geometry.
must_preserve: crisp black ink edges against snow

motifs.name: foreground_gate_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the small foreground gateway pavilion at the lower center-left, including the arched opening, roofed upper story, flanking walls, and the snowy path entering beneath it.
must_preserve: path marks leading into the gate

motifs.name: left_foreground_winter_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the dense leafless winter tree grove on the lower-left hillside, including the tall trunks, branching crowns, smaller saplings, and the immediate ink-textured snowy mound supporting them.
must_preserve: snowy mound contours and light rock texture beneath the trees

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
